quotations.old_english: Sió godcunde fóreteohhung is ánfeald and unawendendlíc
quotations.english: the divine predestination is simple and unchangeable

source_text: fóre-teohung, -teohhung, e; f. Predestination; prædest&i-short;n&a-long;tio :-- Sió godcunde fóreteohhung is ánfeald and unawendendlíc the divine predestination is simple and unchangeable, Bt. 39, 6; Fox 220, 16. Be ðære fóreteohunga Godes concerning the predestination of God, Bt. titl. xxxix; Fox xviii. 16. v. fóre-tiohung.
